name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.scalar_circle_parseval
statement:
theorem scalar_circle_parseval (f : BoundaryCircle → ℂ) (hf : Continuous f) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℤ => ‖fourierCoeff f k‖ ^ 2)
      (∫ t, ‖f t‖ ^ 2 ∂circleMeasure)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.anti_cross_energy
statement:
theorem anti_cross_energy {ι : Type u_82} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (M L : BoundaryCircle → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hM : Continuous M) (hL : Continuous L)
    (hMp : ∀ k : ℤ, 0 < k → fourierCoeff M k = 0)
    (hLp : ∀ k : ℤ, 0 < k → fourierCoeff L k = 0)
    (hzero : (fourierCoeff L 0)ᴴ = fourierCoeff M 0) :
    (∫ t, hsSq (M t) ∂circleMeasure) ≤
      ∫ t, hsSq (M t + (L t)ᴴ) ∂circleMeasure

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.anti_diagonal_energy
statement:
theorem anti_diagonal_energy {ι : Type u_81} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (P : BoundaryCircle → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hP : Continuous P)
    (hpos : ∀ k : ℤ, 0 < k → fourierCoeff P k = 0)
    (hzero : (fourierCoeff P 0).IsHermitian) :
    (∫ t, hsSq (P t + (P t)ᴴ) ∂circleMeasure) =
      4 * (hsSq (fourierCoeff P 0) +
        (1/2 : ℝ) * ∑' n : ℕ, hsSq (fourierCoeff P (-(n+1))))

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.anti_matrix_energy
statement:
theorem anti_matrix_energy {ι : Type u_80} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

    (hpos : ∀ k : ℤ, 0 < k → fourierCoeff P k = 0) :
    (∫ t, hsSq (P t) ∂circleMeasure) = hsSq (fourierCoeff P 0) +
      ∑' n : ℕ, hsSq (fourierCoeff P (-(n+1)))

statement: theorem faberWeight_pos (k : ℕ) : 0 < faberWeight k

statement:
theorem fourierCoeff_add_star {ι : Type u_79} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (P Q : BoundaryCircle → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hP : Continuous P) (hQ : Continuous Q) (k : ℤ) :

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.hsSq_add_self
statement:
theorem hsSq_add_self {ι : Type u_77} {κ : Type u_78} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] (A : Matrix ι κ ℂ) :

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.hsSq_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem hsSq_zero {ι : Type u_75} {κ : Type u_76} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] :

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.matrix_energy_split
statement:
theorem matrix_energy_split {ι : Type u_73} {κ : Type u_74} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ]
    (f : BoundaryCircle → Matrix ι κ ℂ) (hf : Continuous f) :
    (∫ t, hsSq (f t) ∂circleMeasure) =
      (∑' n : ℕ, hsSq (fourierCoeff f (n+1))) + hsSq (fourierCoeff f 0) +

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.weighted_sequence_dual
statement:
theorem weighted_sequence_dual {ι : Type u_85} {κ : Type u_86} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (P : ℕ → Matrix ι κ ℂ) (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (h : ∀ N (C : Fin N → Matrix ι κ ℂ),
      ‖∑ k : Fin N, entryPair (P k) (C k)‖ ^ 2 ≤ b * ∑ k : Fin N, faberWeight k * hsSq (C k)) :
    hsSq (P 0) + (1/2 : ℝ) * ∑' n : ℕ, hsSq (P (n+1)) ≤ b

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.continuous_matrixPolynomialValue
statement:
theorem continuous_matrixPolynomialValue {m : ℕ} (G : MatrixPolynomial m) :
    Continuous (fun z => matrixPolynomialValue z G)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.cross_boundary_estimate
statement:
theorem cross_boundary_estimate {n m : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (b : ℕ → Polynomial ℂ) (h : BoundaryCircle → ℂ)
    (hexpand : ∀ G : MatrixPolynomial m, ∃ (N : ℕ) (C : Fin N → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ),
      G = faberPolynomial b C)
    (hlower : ∀ N (C : Fin N → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ),
      ∑ k, hsSq (C k) ≤ polynomialEnergy h (faberPolynomial b C))
    (R : BoundaryCircle → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (hR : Continuous R)
    (hcoeff : ∀ k : ℕ, fourierCoeff R (-(k : ℤ)) = Polynomial.aeval A (b k))
    (X Y : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) ℂ) (G : MatrixPolynomial m) :
    ‖inner ℂ (hsVector Y) (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n × Fin m) (𝕜 := ℂ)
      (tensorPolynomial A G) (hsVector X))‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (∫ t, hsSq (Yᴴ * R t * X) ∂circleMeasure) * polynomialEnergy h G

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.faber_pairing
statement:
theorem faber_pairing {n m N : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (b : ℕ → Polynomial ℂ) (C : Fin N → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ)
    (X Y : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) ℂ) :
    inner ℂ (hsVector Y) (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n × Fin m) (𝕜 := ℂ)
      (tensorPolynomial A (faberPolynomial b C)) (hsVector X)) =
      ∑ k : Fin N, entryPair (Yᴴ * Polynomial.aeval A (b k) * X) (C k)

@[simp] theorem matrixPolynomialValue_C {m : ℕ} (z : ℂ)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.matrixPolynomialValue_faber

theorem matrixPolynomialValue_faber {m N : ℕ} (b : ℕ → Polynomial ℂ)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.polynomialEnergy_mul_le
statement:
theorem polynomialEnergy_mul_le {m : ℕ} (h : BoundaryCircle → ℂ) (hh : Continuous h)

    polynomialEnergy h (F * G) ≤ polynomialEnergy h G ∧
    polynomialEnergy h (G * F) ≤ polynomialEnergy h G

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.polynomialEnergy_nonneg
statement:
theorem polynomialEnergy_nonneg {m : ℕ} (h : BoundaryCircle → ℂ) (G : MatrixPolynomial m) :

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.singular_diagonal_estimates
statement:
theorem singular_diagonal_estimates {n m : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (b : ℕ → Polynomial ℂ) (h : BoundaryCircle → ℂ) (hh : Continuous h)
    (hexpand : ∀ G : MatrixPolynomial m, ∃ (N : ℕ) (C : Fin N → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ),
      G = faberPolynomial b C)
    (hlower : ∀ N (C : Fin N → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ),
      ∑ k, hsSq (C k) ≤ polynomialEnergy h (faberPolynomial b C))
    (hupper : ∀ N (C : Fin N → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ),
      polynomialEnergy h (faberPolynomial b C) ≤ ∑ k : Fin N, faberWeight k * hsSq (C k))
    (R : BoundaryCircle → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (hR : Continuous R)
    (hcoeff : ∀ k : ℕ, fourierCoeff R (-(k : ℤ)) = Polynomial.aeval A (b k))
    (F : MatrixPolynomial m) (hF : ∀ t, ‖matrixPolynomialValue (h t) F‖ ≤ 1)
    (X Y : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) ℂ) (γ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ)
    (hFx : Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n × Fin m) (𝕜 := ℂ) (tensorPolynomial A F) (hsVector X) =
      (γ : ℂ) • hsVector Y)
    (hFy : ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint
      (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n × Fin m) (𝕜 := ℂ) (tensorPolynomial A F)) (hsVector Y) =
      (γ : ℂ) • hsVector X) :
    let a := ∫ t, hsSq (Yᴴ * R t * X) ∂circleMeasure
    (hsSq (Xᴴ * Polynomial.aeval A (b 0) * X) + (1/2 : ℝ) *
      ∑' k : ℕ, hsSq (Xᴴ * Polynomial.aeval A (b (k+1)) * X) ≤ a / γ^2) ∧
    (hsSq (Yᴴ * Polynomial.aeval A (b 0) * Y) + (1/2 : ℝ) *
      ∑' k : ℕ, hsSq (Yᴴ * Polynomial.aeval A (b (k+1)) * Y) ≤ a / γ^2)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.singular_ordered_pairings
statement:
theorem singular_ordered_pairings {n m : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (F G : MatrixPolynomial m) (x y : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n × Fin m)) (γ : ℝ)
    (hFx : Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n × Fin m) (𝕜 := ℂ) (tensorPolynomial A F) x =
      (γ : ℂ) • y)
    (hFy : ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint
      (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n × Fin m) (𝕜 := ℂ) (tensorPolynomial A F)) y =
      (γ : ℂ) • x) :
    inner ℂ y (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n × Fin m) (𝕜 := ℂ) (tensorPolynomial A (F * G)) x) =
      (γ : ℂ)
      * inner ℂ x (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n × Fin m) (𝕜 := ℂ) (tensorPolynomial A G) x) ∧
    inner ℂ y (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n × Fin m) (𝕜 := ℂ) (tensorPolynomial A (G * F)) x) =
      (γ : ℂ)
      * inner ℂ y (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n × Fin m) (𝕜 := ℂ) (tensorPolynomial A G) y)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.tensorPolynomial_faber
statement:
theorem tensorPolynomial_faber {n m N : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.analytic_domain_core
statement:
theorem analytic_domain_core {n m : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hm : 0 < m)
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (b : ℕ → Polynomial ℂ) (hb0 : b 0 = 1)
    (h : BoundaryCircle → ℂ) (hh : Continuous h)
    (hexpand : ∀ G : MatrixPolynomial m, ∃ (N : ℕ) (C : Fin N → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ),
      G = faberPolynomial b C)
    (hlower : ∀ N (C : Fin N → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ),
      ∑ k, hsSq (C k) ≤ polynomialEnergy h (faberPolynomial b C))
    (hupper : ∀ N (C : Fin N → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ),
      polynomialEnergy h (faberPolynomial b C) ≤ ∑ k : Fin N, faberWeight k * hsSq (C k))
    (R : BoundaryCircle → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (hR : Continuous R)
    (hcoeff : ∀ k : ℕ, fourierCoeff R (-(k : ℤ)) = Polynomial.aeval A (b k))
    (hposfreq : ∀ k : ℤ, 0 < k → fourierCoeff R k = 0)
    (hpositive : ∀ t, (R t + (R t)ᴴ).PosSemidef)
    (F : MatrixPolynomial m) (hF : ∀ t, ‖matrixPolynomialValue (h t) F‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖tensorPolynomial A F‖ ≤ 2

statement:
theorem chordIntegral_deriv_eq_dslope {s : Set ℂ} (hconv : Convex ℝ s)

statement:
theorem chordIntegral_deriv_mul {s : Set ℂ} (hconv : Convex ℝ s)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.analyticOnNhd_correction_left
statement:
theorem analyticOnNhd_correction_left {s : Set ℂ} (hs : IsOpen s) (hconv : Convex ℝ s)
    {g : ℂ → ℂ} (hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g s) {c v : ℂ} (hv : v ∈ s)
    (hH : ∀ u ∈ s, chordDenominator c g u v ≠ 0) :
    AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun u => correction c g u v) s

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.analyticOnNhd_correction_right
statement:
theorem analyticOnNhd_correction_right {s : Set ℂ} (hs : IsOpen s) (hconv : Convex ℝ s)
    {g : ℂ → ℂ} (hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g s) {c u : ℂ} (hu : u ∈ s)
    (hH : ∀ v ∈ s, chordDenominator c g u v ≠ 0) :
    AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (correction c g u) s

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.chordDenominator_diagonal
statement:
theorem chordDenominator_diagonal {s : Set ℂ} (hconv : Convex ℝ s)
    {g : ℂ → ℂ} (hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g s) (c : ℂ) {u : ℂ} (hu : u ∈ s) :
    chordDenominator c g u u = c-u^2*deriv g u

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.chordDenominator_ne_zero
statement:
theorem chordDenominator_ne_zero {s : Set ℂ} (hconv : Convex ℝ s)
    {g : ℂ → ℂ} (hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g s) {c : ℂ} (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hinj : InjOn (exterior c g) (Inv.inv ⁻¹' s \ {0}))
    (hd : ∀ ζ, ζ ≠ 0 → ζ⁻¹ ∈ s → deriv (exterior c g) ζ ≠ 0)
    {u v : ℂ} (hu : u ∈ s) (hv : v ∈ s) : chordDenominator c g u v ≠ 0

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.chordDenominator_off_diagonal
statement:
theorem chordDenominator_off_diagonal {s : Set ℂ} (hconv : Convex ℝ s)
    {g : ℂ → ℂ} (hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g s) (c : ℂ) {u v : ℂ}
    (hu : u ∈ s) (hv : v ∈ s) (hu0 : u ≠ 0) (hv0 : v ≠ 0) (huv : u ≠ v) :
    chordDenominator c g u v = (exterior c g u⁻¹ - exterior c g v⁻¹) / (u⁻¹-v⁻¹)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.continuousOn_correction
statement:
theorem continuousOn_correction {s : Set ℂ} (hs : IsOpen s) (hconv : Convex ℝ s)
    {g : ℂ → ℂ} (hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g s) {c : ℂ}
    (hH : ∀ u ∈ s, ∀ v ∈ s, chordDenominator c g u v ≠ 0) :
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => correction c g p.1 p.2) (s ×ˢ s)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.correction_identity
statement:
theorem correction_identity {s : Set ℂ} (hs : IsOpen s) (hconv : Convex ℝ s)
    {g : ℂ → ℂ} (hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g s) (c : ℂ) {u v : ℂ}
    (hu : u ∈ s) (hv : v ∈ s) (hv0 : v ≠ 0) (huv : u ≠ v)
    (hH : chordDenominator c g u v ≠ 0) :
    correction c g u v = (c-u^2*deriv g u)/(c+u*(g u-exterior c g v⁻¹)) - (1-u/v)⁻¹

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.correction_zero_left
statement: @[simp] theorem correction_zero_left (c : ℂ) (g : ℂ → ℂ) (v : ℂ) : correction c g 0 v = 0

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.correction_zero_right
statement: @[simp] theorem correction_zero_right (c : ℂ) (g : ℂ → ℂ) (u : ℂ) : correction c g u 0 = 0

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.divided_derivative_relation
statement:
theorem divided_derivative_relation {s : Set ℂ} (hs : IsOpen s) (hconv : Convex ℝ s)
    {g : ℂ → ℂ} (hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g s) {u v : ℂ} (hu : u ∈ s) (hv : v ∈ s) :
    divided g u v + (u-v)*dividedLeft g u v = deriv g u

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.divided_eq_dslope
statement:
theorem divided_eq_dslope {s : Set ℂ} (hconv : Convex ℝ s)
    {g : ℂ → ℂ} (hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g s) {u v : ℂ} (hu : u ∈ s) (hv : v ∈ s) :
    divided g u v = dslope g v u

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.divided_fundamental
statement:
theorem divided_fundamental {s : Set ℂ} (hconv : Convex ℝ s)
    {g : ℂ → ℂ} (hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g s) {u v : ℂ} (hu : u ∈ s) (hv : v ∈ s) :
    (u-v)*divided g u v = g u-g v

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.fourierCoeff_of_analytic
statement:
theorem fourierCoeff_of_analytic {E : Type u_105} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    [CompleteSpace E] {f : ℂ → E} {R : ℝ} (hR : 1 < R)
    (hf : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f (ball 0 R)) (k : ℤ) :
    fourierCoeff (fun t : Angle => f (unitPoint t)) k =
      if 0 ≤ k then taylorCoeff f k.toNat else 0

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.fourierCoeff_of_powerSeries
statement:
theorem fourierCoeff_of_powerSeries {E : Type u_104} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    [CompleteSpace E] {f : ℂ → E} {p : FormalMultilinearSeries ℂ ℂ E} {r : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hp : HasFPowerSeriesOnBall f p 0 r) (hr : 1 < r) (k : ℤ) :
    fourierCoeff (fun t : Angle => f (unitPoint t)) k =
      if 0 ≤ k then taylorCoeff f k.toNat else 0

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.integral_character_smul
statement:
theorem integral_character_smul {E : Type u_103} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    [CompleteSpace E] (a b : ℤ) (v : E) :
    (∫ t : Angle, fourier (-a) t • (fourier b t • v) ∂angularMeasure) = if b = a then v else 0

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.taylorCoeff_add
statement:
theorem taylorCoeff_add {E : Type u_97} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    {f g : ℂ → E} (hf : AnalyticAt ℂ f 0) (hg : AnalyticAt ℂ g 0) (k : ℕ) :
    taylorCoeff (fun z => f z+g z) k = taylorCoeff f k+taylorCoeff g k

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.taylorCoeff_congr
statement:
theorem taylorCoeff_congr {E : Type u_96} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    {f g : ℂ → E} (h : f =ᶠ[𝓝 0] g) (k : ℕ) : taylorCoeff f k = taylorCoeff g k

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.taylorCoeff_const
statement:
@[simp] theorem taylorCoeff_const {E : Type u_101} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    (v : E) (k : ℕ) : taylorCoeff (fun _ => v) k = if k = 0 then v else 0

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.taylorCoeff_eq_series
statement:
theorem taylorCoeff_eq_series {E : Type u_102} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    [CompleteSpace E]
    {f : ℂ → E} {p : FormalMultilinearSeries ℂ ℂ E} {r : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hp : HasFPowerSeriesOnBall f p 0 r) (k : ℕ) : taylorCoeff f k = p.coeff k

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.taylorCoeff_pow_mul
statement:
theorem taylorCoeff_pow_mul {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : AnalyticAt ℂ f 0) (j k : ℕ) :
    taylorCoeff (fun u => u^j*f u) k = if j ≤ k then taylorCoeff f (k-j) else 0

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.taylorCoeff_smul_const
statement:
theorem taylorCoeff_smul_const {E : Type u_100} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : AnalyticAt ℂ f 0) (v : E) (k : ℕ) :
    taylorCoeff (fun z => f z • v) k = taylorCoeff f k • v

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.taylorCoeff_sum
statement:
theorem taylorCoeff_sum {E : Type u_98} {ι : Type u_99} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    [CompleteSpace E]
    (I : Finset ι) {f : ι → ℂ → E} (hf : ∀ i ∈ I, AnalyticAt ℂ (f i) 0) (k : ℕ) :
    taylorCoeff (fun z => ∑ i ∈ I, f i z) k = ∑ i ∈ I, taylorCoeff (f i) k

statement:
theorem faberBasis_degree {c : ℂ} (hc : c ≠ 0) {g : ℂ → ℂ} (hg : AnalyticAt ℂ g 0) (k : ℕ) :
    (faberBasis c g k).degree = k

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.faberBasis_eval
statement:
theorem faberBasis_eval (c : ℂ) (g : ℂ → ℂ) (k : ℕ) (z : ℂ) :
    (faberBasis c g k).eval z = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1),
      taylorCoeff (fun u => localN c g u * localW c g u^j) k * z^j

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.faberBasis_exterior
statement:
theorem faberBasis_exterior {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) {g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g (ball 0 R)) {c : ℂ} (hc : c ≠ 0)
    {v : ℂ} (hv : v ∈ ball 0 R) (hv0 : v ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ u ∈ ball 0 R, chordDenominator c g u v ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
    (faberBasis c g k).eval (exterior c g v⁻¹) = v⁻¹^k +
      taylorCoeff (fun u => correction c g u v) k

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.faberBasis_zero
statement: theorem faberBasis_zero {c : ℂ} (hc : c ≠ 0) (g : ℂ → ℂ) : faberBasis c g 0 = 1

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.fourierCoeff_comp_neg

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.fourierCoeff_of_antianalytic
statement:
theorem fourierCoeff_of_antianalytic {E : Type u_107} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]

    (hf : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f (ball 0 R)) (k : ℤ) :
    fourierCoeff (fun t : Angle => f ((unitPoint t)⁻¹)) k =
      if k ≤ 0 then taylorCoeff f (-k).toNat else 0

statement:
theorem scalarGenerating_eq_local {c : ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ} {z u : ℂ}

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.taylorCoeff_geometric
statement:
theorem taylorCoeff_geometric (z : ℂ) (k : ℕ) :

    [SecondCountableTopology α]

    [SecondCountableTopology β]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (μ : Measure α) (ν : Measure β) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (K : α → β → ℝ) (u : α → E)
    (hK : Continuous K.uncurry) (hu : Continuous u)
    (hpos : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y)
    (hcol : ∀ y, ∫ x, K x y ∂μ = 1)
    (hrow : ∀ x, ∫ y, K x y ∂ν = 1) :

    (Continuous (fun t : Angle => algebraGenerating c g A (unitPoint t)⁻¹)) ∧
    (∀ k : ℕ, fourierCoeff (fun t : Angle => algebraGenerating c g A (unitPoint t)⁻¹)
      (-(k:ℤ)) = Polynomial.aeval A (faberBasis c g k)) ∧

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.exterior_collar_bound
statement:
theorem exterior_collar_bound {n m : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hm : 0 < m)
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 1 < R) {g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g (ball 0 R)) {c : ℂ} (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hinj : InjOn (Faber.exterior c g) (Inv.inv ⁻¹' ball 0 R \ {0}))
    (hder : ∀ ζ : ℂ, ζ ≠ 0 → ζ⁻¹ ∈ ball 0 R → deriv (Faber.exterior c g) ζ ≠ 0)
    (hboundary : ∀ t s, 0 ≤ (conj (Faber.boundaryNormal c g t) *
      (Faber.boundary c g t-Faber.boundary c g s)).re)
    (houtside : ∀ ζ : ℂ, 1 ≤ ‖ζ‖ → Faber.exterior c g ζ ∉ numericalRange A)
    (hsupport : ∀ t, ∀ w ∈ numericalRange A,
      0 ≤ (conj (Faber.boundaryNormal c g t) * (Faber.boundary c g t-w)).re)
    (F : MatrixPolynomial m) (hF : ∀ t, ‖matrixPolynomialValue (Faber.boundary c g t) F‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖tensorPolynomial A F‖ ≤ 2

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.faber_matrix_coefficient_bounds
statement:
theorem faber_matrix_coefficient_bounds {R : ℝ} (hR : 1 < R) {g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g (ball 0 R)) {c : ℂ} (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ u ∈ ball 0 R, ∀ v ∈ ball 0 R, Faber.chordDenominator c g u v ≠ 0)
    (hpositive : ∀ t s, 0 ≤ Faber.boundaryKernel c g t s)
    {m N : ℕ} (C : Fin N → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) :
    (∑ k, hsSq (C k) ≤ polynomialEnergy (Faber.boundary c g) (faberPolynomial (Faber.faberBasis c g) C))
    ∧
      (polynomialEnergy (Faber.boundary c g) (faberPolynomial (Faber.faberBasis c g) C) ≤
        ∑ k : Fin N, faberWeight k * hsSq (C k))

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.faber_resolvent_data
statement:
theorem faber_resolvent_data {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 1 < R) {g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g (ball 0 R)) {c : ℂ} (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (houtside : ∀ ζ : ℂ, 1 ≤ ‖ζ‖ → Faber.exterior c g ζ ∉ numericalRange A)
    (hsupport : ∀ t, ∀ w ∈ numericalRange A,
      0 ≤ (conj (Faber.boundaryNormal c g t) * (Faber.boundary c g t-w)).re) :
    ∃ Q : BoundaryCircle → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ,
      Continuous Q ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, fourierCoeff Q (-(k:ℤ)) = Polynomial.aeval A (Faber.faberBasis c g k)) ∧
      (∀ k : ℤ, 0 < k → fourierCoeff Q k = 0) ∧
      (∀ t, (Q t+(Q t)ᴴ).PosSemidef)

statement:
theorem boundary_germs_compatible {U : Set ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U)
    {p q z : ℂ} (hp : p ∈ closure U) (hq : q ∈ closure U)
    {r s : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hzp : z ∈ ball p r) (hzq : z ∈ ball q s)
    {E G f : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hE : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ E (ball p (3*r)))
    (hG : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ G (ball q (3*s)))
    (he : EqOn E f (ball p (3*r) ∩ U))
    (hg : EqOn G f (ball q (3*s) ∩ U)) : E z = G z

    (hi : InjOn F U) (hm : F '' U = ball 0 1)
    (hside : ∀ z ∈ V, ‖F z‖ < 1 ↔ z ∈ U)
    (hd : ∀ p ∈ closure U, deriv F p ≠ 0) : InjOn F (closure U)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Conformal.patch_boundary_germs
statement:
theorem patch_boundary_germs {U : Set ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U) {f : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hloc : ∀ p ∈ closure U, ∃ r > 0, ∃ E : ℂ → ℂ,
      AnalyticOnNhd ℂ E (ball p (3*r)) ∧ EqOn E f (ball p (3*r) ∩ U) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ ball p (3*r), ‖E z‖ < 1 ↔ z ∈ U) ∧ deriv E p ≠ 0) :
    ∃ V : Set ℂ, ∃ F : ℂ → ℂ, IsOpen V ∧ closure U ⊆ V ∧
      AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F V ∧ EqOn F f U ∧
      (∀ z ∈ V, ‖F z‖ < 1 ↔ z ∈ U) ∧ (∀ p ∈ closure U, deriv F p ≠ 0)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Conformal.univalent_neighborhood_of_disk_side
statement:
theorem univalent_neighborhood_of_disk_side {U V : Set ℂ} (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hUV : closure U ⊆ V) (hUc : IsCompact (closure U))
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hF : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F V)
    (hi : InjOn F U) (hm : F '' U = ball 0 1)
    (hside : ∀ z ∈ V, ‖F z‖ < 1 ↔ z ∈ U)
    (hd : ∀ p ∈ closure U, deriv F p ≠ 0) :
    ∃ W, IsOpen W ∧ closure U ⊆ W ∧ W ⊆ V ∧
      InjOn F W ∧ AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F W ∧ F '' closure U = closedBall 0 1

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Geometry.analytic_complex_chart

theorem analytic_complex_chart {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : AnalyticAt ℂ f 0)
    (hd : deriv f 0 ≠ 0) {P : ℂ → Prop} (hP : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 0, P z) :
    ∃ U : OpenPartialHomeomorph ℂ ℂ, (U : ℂ → ℂ) = f ∧ 0 ∈ U.source ∧
      AnalyticOnNhd ℂ U U.source ∧ AnalyticOnNhd ℂ U.symm U.target ∧
      deriv U.symm (f 0) ≠ 0 ∧ (∀ z ∈ U.source, P z)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Geometry.analytic_inverse_chart

theorem analytic_inverse_chart {E : Type u_133} {F : Type u_134} [NormedAddCommGroup E]

    {f : E → F} {x : E} (ha : AnalyticAt ℂ f x) (e : E ≃L[ℂ] F)
    (hd : HasFDerivAt f e.toContinuousLinearMap x) :
    ∃ U : OpenPartialHomeomorph E F, (U : E → F) = f ∧ x ∈ U.source ∧
      AnalyticAt ℂ U.symm (f x)

      InjOn (fun ζ => c*ζ+g ζ⁻¹) (Inv.inv ⁻¹' ball 0 R \ {0}) ∧

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Geometry.exists_exponential_outer

    ∃ (D : Finset ℂ) (v : D → ℂ) (b : D → ℝ),
      (∀ z ∈ K, expLevel v b z < 1) ∧
      IsCompact {z | expLevel v b z ≤ 1} ∧

name: OAI.ForestSpace.segment_cut
statement:
theorem segment_cut (hF : ForestOrder V) {H : Set V} (hH : IsLowerSet H)
    {f k : V → ℝ} (hf : SupportedOn f H) (hk : SupportedOn k Hᶜ)
    {s τ : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hτ : |τ| ≤ 1)
    {S : Finset V} (hS : IsSegment S) :
    ∃ L : Finset V, L ⊆ S.filter (· ∈ H) ∧ IsSegment L ∧
      IsSegment (S.filter (· ∈ H) \ L) ∧
      (segSum f S + s * segSum (correctedTail H f k s τ) S) ^ 2 ≤
        (segSum f S - segSum f L) ^ 2 + segSum f L ^ 2 +
        8 * s ^ 2 * (∑ v ∈ S, gateWeight H k v) +
        s ^ 2 * segSum (correctedTail H f k s τ) S ^ 2

    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (S i) (S j)))
    (hL : ∀ i, L i ⊆ (S i).filter (· ∈ H))
    (hseg : ∀ i, IsSegment (L i))
    (hdiff : ∀ i, IsSegment ((S i).filter (· ∈ H) \ L i)) :
    (∑ i, ((segSum f (S i) - segSum f (L i)) ^ 2 + segSum f (L i) ^ 2)) ≤ 1

name: OAI.Brennan.exists_odd_transform
statement:
lemma exists_odd_transform {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : Schlicht f) :
    ∃ q g h H : ℂ → ℂ,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ q disk ∧ q 0 = 1 ∧
      (∀ z ∈ disk, q z ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ disk, q z^2 = dslope f 0 z) ∧
      (∀ z, g z = z*q (z^2)) ∧
      UnivalentOn g disk ∧ g 0 = 0 ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ h disk ∧ deriv h 0 = -deriv q 0 ∧
      (∀ z ∈ disk, z ≠ 0 → H z = z⁻¹+h z) ∧
      UnivalentOn H (disk \ {0}) ∧
      deriv (deriv f) 0 = 4*deriv q 0

lemma deriv_targetRatio_at_critical {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : UnivalentOn f halfPlane)
    {k : ℝ} (hk : k ≠ 0) {z ξ : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ halfPlane)
    (hc : criticalMap f k z = ξ) :
    deriv (targetRatio f ξ) z = (k : ℂ) * (k + logarithmicJet f z) / (z.im : ℂ)^2

name: OAI.Brennan.det_realHessian_at_critical
statement:
lemma det_realHessian_at_critical {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : UnivalentOn f halfPlane)
    {k : ℝ} (hk : k ≠ 0) {z ξ : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ halfPlane)
    (hc : criticalMap f k z = ξ) :
    (realHessian (logPotential f k ξ) z).det =
      -(k^4 / z.im^4) * normalizedJacobian f k z

statement:

OAI.Brennan.fderiv_criticalMap_apply
statement:
lemma fderiv_criticalMap_apply {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : UnivalentOn f halfPlane)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ halfPlane) (k : ℝ) (v : ℂ) :
    fderiv ℝ (criticalMap f k) z v = deriv f z * v -
      Complex.I / (k : ℂ) * ((v.im : ℂ) * deriv f z +
        (z.im : ℂ) * (deriv (deriv f) z * v))

name: OAI.Brennan.fderiv_logPotential_apply
statement:
lemma fderiv_logPotential_apply {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : UnivalentOn f halfPlane)
    {z ξ : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ halfPlane) (hp : f z ≠ ξ) (k : ℝ) (v : ℂ) :
    fderiv ℝ (logPotential f k ξ) z v =
      k / z.im * v.im - (deriv f z * v / (f z - ξ)).re

name: OAI.Brennan.fderiv_log_norm_apply
statement:
lemma fderiv_log_norm_apply {g : ℂ → ℂ} {d z : ℂ} (hg : HasDerivAt g d z)
    (hn : g z ≠ 0) (v : ℂ) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun w => Real.log ‖g w‖) z v = (d * v / g z).re

name: OAI.Brennan.finite_critical_superlevel
statement:
lemma finite_critical_superlevel {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : UnivalentOn f halfPlane)
    {k : ℝ} {ξ : ℂ} (hg : GoodPair f k ξ) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    {z | z ∈ halfPlane ∧ criticalMap f k z = ξ ∧
      ENNReal.ofReal h ≤ potential f k ξ z}.Finite

name: OAI.Brennan.logarithmicJet_eq
statement:
lemma logarithmicJet_eq {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : UnivalentOn f halfPlane)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ halfPlane) :
    logarithmicJet f z = -Complex.I * (z.im : ℂ) * deriv (deriv f) z / deriv f z

name: OAI.Brennan.logarithmicJet_reroot
statement:
lemma logarithmicJet_reroot {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : UnivalentOn f halfPlane)
    {z w : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ halfPlane) (hw : w ∈ halfPlane) :
    logarithmicJet (reroot f z) w = logarithmicJet f (affine z w)

name: OAI.Brennan.normalizedJacobian_formula
statement:
lemma normalizedJacobian_formula {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : UnivalentOn f halfPlane)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ halfPlane) (k : ℝ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    k^2 * normalizedJacobian f k z =
      k * (k - 1) + (2*k - 1) * (logarithmicJet f z).re + ‖logarithmicJet f z‖^2

name: OAI.Brennan.normalizedJacobian_reroot
statement:
lemma normalizedJacobian_reroot {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : UnivalentOn f halfPlane)
    {z w : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ halfPlane) (hw : w ∈ halfPlane) (k : ℝ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    normalizedJacobian (reroot f z) k w = normalizedJacobian f k (affine z w)

name: OAI.Brennan.potential_critical_height
statement:
lemma potential_critical_height {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : UnivalentOn f halfPlane)

name: OAI.Brennan.ratio_at_critical
statement:
lemma ratio_at_critical {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : UnivalentOn f halfPlane)
    {k : ℝ} {z ξ : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ halfPlane)
    (hc : criticalMap f k z = ξ) :
    deriv f z / (f z - ξ) = -Complex.I * (k : ℂ) / (z.im : ℂ)

name: OAI.Brennan.realHessian_at_critical
statement:
lemma realHessian_at_critical {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : UnivalentOn f halfPlane)
    {k : ℝ} (hk : k ≠ 0) {z ξ : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ halfPlane)
    (hc : criticalMap f k z = ξ) :
    realHessian (logPotential f k ξ) z =
      (k / z.im^2) •
        !![-(k + (logarithmicJet f z).re), (logarithmicJet f z).im;
          (logarithmicJet f z).im, k - 1 + (logarithmicJet f z).re]

name: OAI.Brennan.realHessian_logPotential
statement:
lemma realHessian_logPotential {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : UnivalentOn f halfPlane)
    {z ξ : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ halfPlane) (hp : f z ≠ ξ) (k : ℝ) :
    realHessian (logPotential f k ξ) z =
      !![-(deriv (targetRatio f ξ) z).re, (deriv (targetRatio f ξ) z).im;
        (deriv (targetRatio f ξ) z).im, -k / z.im^2 + (deriv (targetRatio f ξ) z).re]

name: OAI.Brennan.secondDirectional_logPotential_I
statement:
lemma secondDirectional_logPotential_I {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : UnivalentOn f halfPlane)
    {z ξ : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ halfPlane) (hp : f z ≠ ξ) (k : ℝ) (v : ℂ) :
    secondDirectional (logPotential f k ξ) z Complex.I v =
      -k / z.im^2 * v.im + (deriv (targetRatio f ξ) z * v).im

name: OAI.Brennan.secondDirectional_logPotential_one
statement:
lemma secondDirectional_logPotential_one {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : UnivalentOn f halfPlane)

    secondDirectional (logPotential f k ξ) z 1 v =

name: OAI.Brennan.trace_realHessian_logPotential
statement:
lemma trace_realHessian_logPotential {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : UnivalentOn f halfPlane)

name: OAI.Brennan.det_regularizedGradient_at_critical
statement:
lemma det_regularizedGradient_at_critical {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : UnivalentOn f halfPlane)

statement:
lemma compact_regular_level_oriented_curves {f : ℂ → ℝ} {c d : ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (hs : HasCompactSupport (fun z => f z-d))
    (hreg : ∀ z, f z = c → fderiv ℝ f z ≠ 0)
    (hK : IsCompact {z | f z = c}) :
    ∃ C : Finset (Set ℂ), (⋃ S ∈ C, S) = {z | f z = c} ∧
      (∀ S ∈ C, ∀ T ∈ C, S ≠ T → Disjoint S T) ∧
      ∀ S ∈ C, ∃ γ : ℝ → ℂ, range γ = S ∧ ContDiff ℝ 1 γ ∧
        Periodic γ 1 ∧ InjOn γ (Ico (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧ (∀ t, deriv γ t ≠ 0) ∧
        (∀ t, (γ 0).re ≤ (γ t).re) ∧ (deriv γ 0).re = 0 ∧ (deriv γ 0).im < 0

    (hf : ∀ z ∈ U, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f z) {d : ℝ}
    (hK : IsCompact {z | z ∈ U ∧ f z ≤ d}) :
    ∃ F : ℂ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 2 F ∧ HasCompactSupport (fun z => F z-d) ∧
      (∀ z, z ∈ U → f z ≤ d → F =ᶠ[𝓝 z] f) ∧
      (∀ z ∉ U, F z = d) ∧
      (∀ z c, c < d → (F z ≤ c ↔ z ∈ U ∧ f z ≤ c)) ∧
      (∀ z c, c < d → (F z < c ↔ z ∈ U ∧ f z < c))

name: OAI.Brennan.potential_level_reroot
statement:
lemma potential_level_reroot {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : UnivalentOn f halfPlane) {k : ℝ} (hk : 0 ≤ k)
    {t : ℂ} (ht : t ∈ halfPlane) (ξ : ℂ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    {z | z ∈ halfPlane ∧ ENNReal.ofReal δ ≤ potential (reroot f t) k (rerootTarget f t ξ) z} =
      (affineHome t ht) ⁻¹' {w | w ∈ halfPlane ∧

statement:
lemma heightRank_reroot {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : UnivalentOn f halfPlane) {k : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k)

    heightRank (criticalHeight (reroot f t) k) (signedFiber (reroot f t) k (rerootTarget f t ξ) σ) z =

lemma targetDensity_eq_height (g : DiskClass) {β k : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k)

name: OAI.Brennan.transportDensity_jacobian
statement:
lemma transportDensity_jacobian (g : DiskClass) (β k σ : ℝ) (hσ : |σ| = 1)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ jacobianRegion g k σ) :
    transportDensity g β z * ENNReal.ofReal (σ * normalizedJacobian (classFun g) k z) =
      ENNReal.ofReal |LinearMap.det (fderiv ℝ (criticalMap (classFun g) k) z).toLinearMap| * targetDensity g β z

name: OAI.Brennan.transport_area
statement:
lemma transport_area (g : DiskClass) (β k σ : ℝ) (hσ : |σ| = 1)
    {h : ℂ → ℝ≥0∞} (hm : Measurable h) :
    (∫⁻ z in halfPlane, transportDensity g β z *
      ENNReal.ofReal (σ * normalizedJacobian (classFun g) k z) * h z) =
    ∫⁻ ξ, fiberSum (criticalMap (classFun g) k) (jacobianRegion g k σ)
      (fun z => targetDensity g β z*h z) ξ

name: OAI.Brennan.weighted_area_formula_regular
statement:
lemma weighted_area_formula_regular {f : ℂ → ℂ} {s : Set ℂ}
    (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hf : ∀ z ∈ s, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 f z)
    (hreg : ∀ z ∈ s, LinearMap.det (fderiv ℝ f z).toLinearMap ≠ 0)
    {u : ℂ → ℝ≥0∞} (hu : Measurable u) :
    Measurable (fiberSum f s u) ∧
    (∫⁻ z in s, ENNReal.ofReal |LinearMap.det (fderiv ℝ f z).toLinearMap| * u z) =
      ∫⁻ y, fiberSum f s u y

    (hq : ∀ z ∈ s, DifferentiableAt ℂ q z)

name: OAI.Brennan.conformal_cutoff_trace_bound
statement:
lemma conformal_cutoff_trace_bound {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ψ : ℂ → ℝ}
    (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → AnalyticAt ℂ F z)
    (hi : InjOn F {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im})
    (hψ : ContDiff ℝ 2 ψ) (hn : ∀ w, 0 ≤ ψ w) (_hψK : HasCompactSupport ψ)
    (hproper : ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → IsCompact ({z : ℂ | η ≤ z.im} ∩ F ⁻¹' tsupport ψ))
    {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 ≤ H)
    (hheight : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → F z ∈ tsupport ψ → z.im ≤ H) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → (∫⁻ x : ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal (ψ (F (x+ε*Complex.I)))) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal H * ∫⁻ w : ℂ, ENNReal.ofReal |Laplacian.laplacian ψ w|

    (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → AnalyticAt ℂ F z)

name: OAI.Brennan.half_trace_lintegral_le
statement:
lemma half_trace_lintegral_le {g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hc : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, 0 < p.2 → ContDiffAt ℝ 2 g p)
    (hn : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, 0 ≤ g p)
    {K : Set (ℝ × ℝ)} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hs : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, ε/2 ≤ p.2 → g p ≠ 0 → p ∈ K) :
    (∫⁻ x : ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal (g (x,ε))) ≤
      ∫⁻ p in {p : ℝ × ℝ | ε ≤ p.2}, ENNReal.ofReal ((p.2-ε)*|pairLaplacian g p|)

    {K : Set (ℝ × ℝ)} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hs : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, ε/2 ≤ p.2 → g p ≠ 0 → p ∈ K) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ε ≤ R ∧ Integrable (fun x : ℝ => g (x,ε)) ∧
      (∫ x : ℝ, g (x,ε)) =
        ∫ p in Icc (-R,ε) (R,R), (p.2-ε)*pairLaplacian g p

lemma rectangle_trace_identity {g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} {R ε Y : ℝ}
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hεY : ε ≤ Y)
    (hg : ∀ p ∈ Icc (-R,ε) (R,Y), ContDiffAt ℝ 2 g p)
    (htop : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-R) R, g (x,Y) = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ g (x,Y) (0,1) = 0)
    (hside : ∀ y ∈ Icc ε Y,
      fderiv ℝ g (-R,y) (1,0) = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ g (R,y) (1,0) = 0) :
    (∫ p in Icc (-R,ε) (R,Y), (p.2-ε)*pairLaplacian g p) =
      ∫ x in -R..R, g (x,ε)

    secondReal (ψ ∘ F) z u v =
      fderiv ℝ ψ (F z) (complexSecondReal F z u v) +
      secondReal ψ (F z) (fderiv ℝ F z u) (fderiv ℝ F z v)

    (hi : InjOn F {z : ℂ | -Real.pi < z.re ∧ z.re < Real.pi ∧ 0 < z.im})
    (hψ : ContDiff ℝ 2 ψ) (hb : Integrable b) (hbn : ∀ w, 0 ≤ b w) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hside : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y →
      fderiv ℝ ((ψ ∘ F) ∘ Complex.equivRealProdCLM.symm) (-Real.pi,y) (1,0) =
      fderiv ℝ ((ψ ∘ F) ∘ Complex.equivRealProdCLM.symm) (Real.pi,y) (1,0))
    (hlap : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → z.im ≤ 1 →
      0 ≤ Laplacian.laplacian (ψ ∘ F) z ∧
      z.im * Laplacian.laplacian (ψ ∘ F) z ≤ K*‖deriv F z‖^2*b (F z)) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 →
      (∫ x in -Real.pi..Real.pi, ψ (F (x+ε*Complex.I))) ≤ C
